findings.description:
FiftyFlip.sendFunds(address,uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_030.sol#323-331) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- success = paidUser.send(amount) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_030.sol#324)

FiftyFlip.play(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_030.sol#162-207) uses a weak PRNG: "jackpotRes = random % JACKPOT_MODULO (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_030.sol#175)"
